About Clockly

Lightweight, high-performance desktop wallpaper clock for Windows.

Clockly

Your wallpaper, now with perfect timing.

Performance

BackendRust (Tauri v2)
Layer TechWindows WorkerW / HWND_BOTTOM
Idle RAM< 50 MB
Idle CPU~0.0%

Embedded directly into the Windows desktop wallpaper surface below desktop icons. Fully click-through, zero busy loops, and it slows down automatically when a fullscreen game or app is running.
